$comment: Single source of truth for the known-good version set across PostGuard
components (EPIC #201, Phase 3 — kill version drift). check-versions.mjs
reads the LIVE versions each repo declares and fails on drift that is not
recorded in `knownDrift`. This ratchets: existing drift is tracked + linked
to an issue, and no NEW drift can be introduced silently.
`current` follows the published latest; the check verifies that, and
bump-manifest.mjs opens the PR that moves it when a producer publishes.

knownDrift.reason: Pins @e4a/pg-js ^1.10.0 — a full major version behind 2.x; cannot resolve the current SDK. Needs a v1→v2 migration.
Uses the legacy `irma` crate at 0.2.1 instead of `irmars` 0.2.2 (what pg-pkg migrated to in #192). Different crate + older version.
